items.title: Dave Williams Interview, 1961-07-02
items.q: Might have heard him there once, I didn't know it. He's gonna pick me back up and got tied, sleeping on the piano at the paddock.

ctx.x: That's right. That's right. That's a long time ago. Yeah, a long years ago when I first came down here, you said. That's right.
I think Burnell played there once, but I don't know if I ever heard him. I didn't know if I did. Burnell, St. Louis. Burnell, St. Louis.
Long time, right? Might have heard him there once, I didn't know it. He's gonna pick me back up and got tied, sleeping on the piano at the paddock. The paddock.
